records.text: Jared Kushner said that in summer 2021 he and others vacationed on Nat Rothschild's boat, were picked up in Montenegro, sailed toward Corfu, and spent several days in Albania.
records.speaker: Jared Kushner

appearances.snippet: So like all things in life, it always just kind of takes its course. I was on a vacation after we left government in the summer of 2021. We were on our friend Nat Rothschild's boat. We got picked up in Montenegro and then we started sailing over to Corfu and we spent a couple of days in Albania.

verification.notes: The transcript is a direct Kushner clip. Contemporary Albanian coverage reproduces his account that the 2021 trip was on Nat Rothschilds boat, began from Montenegro, continued toward Corfu, and included several days in Albania; independent 2026 reporting also identifies Planet Nine as the vessel.
